response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished generalist software engineer with 15+ years of experience across web, mobile, and backend systems, but the resume shows essentially no overlap with the core requirements of a Principal Performance Architect for AI accelerators. There is no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, RTL or microarchitecture work, hardware-software co-design, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, or deep neural network training/inference optimization. The closest adjacent experience is low-latency service work in DLang at Sociomantic and some C/C++ components at National Instruments, which is software-level performance tuning rather than silicon architecture. Education is a BS in Computer Science (meeting the 8+ years experience path formally), but the technical domain mismatch is decisive.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across many stacks
Some low-latency/high-throughput systems and C/C++ embedded exposure
Strong community presence: open-source projects, talks, workshops
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload or GPU/accelerator optimization background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack, not principal-level silicon architecture
